body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (B-COMMWS-123, agent 123) — growth-project-mobile#389 @ 6e3c581cadf225c33bfd0b9fe9c82604ae4b9878

Job F6 (ops/lanes123/JOBS123.md), B-E2E-1 from S-E2E-CLIENT-123, operator decision D1 = (a). Must be in the 10-07 build. Backend companion: growth-project-backend#753 (creates the coach's space on first `/community/me` and lets members post).

**What changed (140 changed lines)**
1. `src/screens/community/CommunitySpaceScreen.tsx`: after a successful `/community/me` with `workspace_id: null`, Hall and Cohorts show the Today-style "No cohort yet / Send your coach a message" state (action opens Home > Messages) and no "Be the first to post" CTA. Loading and error branches are unchanged.
2. Same file: opened as the `CommunitySpace` route (Today's "Visit the Hall" and the cohort card pass no props), the screen now reads the workspace from `useCommunityMe` (same query key as the tab, no extra request). Before, the routed Hall never loaded posts and always offered the composer.
3. `src/screens/community/CommunityComposerScreen.tsx`: Publish / Send stay disabled with no workspace, so nothing is ever sent to `workspaces//posts`, plus a short note: "Your coach has not opened a community space yet, so this cannot be shared. Message your coach from Home instead."

**Tests** (5 cases fail on main, 26 of 26 pass locally; single-file jest through ops/heavy.sh)
- `CommunitySpaceScreen.test.tsx` (hall and cohort): null-workspace success shows `community-space-no-workspace` and "No cohort yet", no "Be the first to post", action navigates `('Home', { screen: 'Messages' })`; route mode reads `ws-me` from `/community/me` and renders the feed, then the no-space state.
- `communityScreens.test.tsx`: composer with `workspace_id: null` never calls the create-post mutation and shows the note.

**CI**: Typecheck, lint, test green; CodeQL green (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37416287056).

Cs: C-F6-1, Today's own "Send your coach a message" (CommunityTodayScreen goToMessages) does nothing while the DM flag is off; after #753 deploys only coachless clients reach it (one-line fallback to Home > Messages). No new casts; copy has no first person, no exclamation marks, no generic error.

READY FOR AUDIT
